implementation.source: text alone, canonical atoms and cached parse/render projections
implementation.output: Owned native light-DOM prose; actual root-scoped generated CSS; private DOM slot is not a consumer content interface
implementation.navigation: Stable host-id prefix or instance prefix, local fragment and ID-reference rewriting, native heading discovery without duplicate HeadingTargets registration
implementation.composition: Shared selective TanStack highlighter and Scroll Area/Viewport for fences and failure fallback
implementation.trust: Default raw HTML escaping and parser URL filtering; explicit trusted-only allowHtml, no added sanitizer or evaluation
implementation.errors: parse/highlight events and safe plain source; failure enum reflects the existing no-sanitizer decision
implementation.labels: Message-catalog updates refresh code/footnote labels without replacing heading nodes

deviations: Prose is native light DOM; its styles retain the source scale while using logical spacing and accessible line-number color.
Native table alignment is represented by generated CSS hooks. Code fences delegate scrolling to the shared viewport.
Component id supplies a stable namespace for generated IDs and their references.
The former child-text source and rendered getter are removed. The old raw .markdown rules and splitter entry are removed.
limits: Trusted HTML remains the application’s responsibility; defaults are not a general HTML sanitizer.
M22/M26 retain final React, scoped-registry and actual assistive-tech checks.
